instruments.name: acid303
instruments.summary: Acid303, a bass voice inspired by the Roland TB-303: saw or square VCO, the diode ladder with accent circuit, a decay envelope, slide, and a 16-step sequencer with gate, accent and slide per step.

instruments.name: bass_pedals
instruments.summary: BassPedals, a monophonic pedal bass synthesizer inspired by the Moog Taurus.

instruments.name: clavichord
instruments.summary: Clavichord, a ten-voice struck-string electric clavichord with two pickups, four tone tabs and a mute, inspired by the Hohner Clavinet D6.

instruments.name: combo_organ
instruments.summary: ComboOrgan, a fully polyphonic divide-down transistor combo organ with footage drawbars, a mixture, two tone colours, a bass octave and a vibrato, inspired by the Vox Continental.

instruments.name: compact_organ
instruments.summary: CompactOrgan, a fully polyphonic divide-down transistor combo organ with voice tabs, a bass section and a pitch vibrato, after the portable combo organs of the mid-1960s.

instruments.name: duo20
instruments.summary: Duo20, a voice inspired by the Korg MS-20: two VCOs, a high-pass into a low-pass Sallen-Key pair with diode-clipped peak, two envelopes, a modulation generator, noise, sample and hold, and a patch panel.

instruments.name: duosynth
instruments.summary: DuoSynth, a duophonic two-oscillator synthesizer inspired by the ARP Odyssey.

instruments.name: electric_grand70
instruments.summary: ElectricGrand70, a ten-voice electric grand piano inspired by the Yamaha CP-70.

instruments.name: electric_piano
instruments.summary: ElectricPiano, a ten-voice tine electric piano inspired by the Fender Rhodes Suitcase 73.

instruments.name: electronic_drums5
instruments.summary: ElectronicDrums5, an electronic drum kit with swept tones and noise hats, inspired by the Simmons SDS-V.

instruments.name: hybrid_mono
instruments.summary: HybridMono, a voice inspired by the EDP Wasp: two DCOs, a CMOS multimode filter whose inverter stages clip, an envelope, an LFO and a VCA, with a small patch panel.

instruments.name: mono101
instruments.summary: Mono101, a monophonic bass and lead synth inspired by the Roland SH-101.

instruments.name: mono_one
instruments.summary: MonoOne, a voice inspired by the Sequential Pro-One: two VCOs with sync, a four-pole filter, two ADSRs, an LFO, glide, and the poly-mod matrix that sends the filter envelope and VCO B to VCO A's frequency and pulse width and to the filter cutoff.

instruments.name: mono_synth
instruments.summary: MonoSynth, a monophonic bass and lead synth inspired by the Moog Minimoog Model D.

instruments.name: patch2600
instruments.summary: Patch2600, a semi-modular voice inspired by the ARP 2600 (and Behringer's 2600): three VCOs, a ladder VCF, a VCA, two envelopes, ring modulator, noise, sample and hold, a voltage processor and a spring reverb.

instruments.name: poly106
instruments.summary: Poly106, a six-voice poly synth inspired by the Roland Juno-106.

instruments.name: poly5
instruments.summary: Poly5, a five-voice two-oscillator poly synth inspired by the Sequential Prophet-5 (rev 3).

instruments.name: poly6
instruments.summary: Poly6, a six-voice poly synth inspired by the Korg Polysix.

instruments.name: poly8
instruments.summary: Poly8, an eight-voice two-oscillator poly synth inspired by the Roland Jupiter-8.

instruments.name: poly80
instruments.summary: Poly80, an eight-voice polysynth inspired by the Yamaha CS-80.

instruments.name: polya6
instruments.summary: PolyA6, a sixteen-voice poly synth inspired by the Alesis Andromeda A6.

instruments.name: polyxa
instruments.summary: PolyXa, an eight-voice two-oscillator poly synth inspired by the Oberheim OB-Xa.

instruments.name: reed_piano
instruments.summary: ReedPiano, a ten-voice plucked-reed electric piano inspired by the Hohner Pianet.

instruments.name: reed_piano200a
instruments.summary: ReedPiano200A, a ten-voice struck-reed electric piano inspired by the Wurlitzer 200A.

instruments.name: rhythm606
instruments.summary: Rhythm606, an analog drum machine with seven sounds, inspired by the Roland TR-606.

instruments.name: rhythm78
instruments.summary: Rhythm78, an analog preset rhythm machine with fifteen sounds, inspired by the Roland CR-78.

instruments.name: rhythm808
instruments.summary: Rhythm808, an analog drum machine with sixteen sounds, one circuit per pad, inspired by the Roland TR-808.

instruments.name: rhythm909
instruments.summary: Rhythm909, a drum machine with eleven synthesized sounds, inspired by the Roland TR-909.

instruments.name: soundfont
instruments.summary: A SoundFont 2 bank as an instrument: every melodic preset under one program change, played through `audiosampler`.

instruments.name: soundfont_drums
instruments.summary: A SoundFont 2 bank's kits as a drum instrument: bank 128, one patch per kit, the General MIDI percussion keys 35-81 as the pads.

instruments.name: state_variable_mono
instruments.summary: StateVariableMono, a voice inspired by the Oberheim SEM: two VCOs, a 12 dB multimode filter that morphs from low-pass through notch to high-pass (or switches to band-pass), two ADS envelopes, an LFO and a VCA, with a patch panel.

instruments.name: string_ensemble
instruments.summary: StringEnsemble, a fully polyphonic divide-down string machine with one shared envelope, a monophonic bass and a three-phase ensemble, inspired by the ARP/Eminent Solina String Ensemble.

instruments.name: tonewheel3
instruments.summary: Tonewheel3, a sixteen-voice tonewheel organ with nine drawbars, single-trigger percussion, key click, a scanner vibrato and chorus, an overdriven rotary speaker, inspired by the Hammond B-3.

instruments.name: vocoder330
instruments.summary: Vocoder330, a fully polyphonic string, choir and ten-band vocoder keyboard, inspired by the Roland VP-330 Vocoder Plus.

instruments.name: west_coast_synth
instruments.summary: WestCoastSynth, a West Coast voice inspired by the Buchla Music Easel: a complex oscillator (modulation and principal oscillators with FM or AM), a timbre wavefolder, two vactrol low-pass gates, two function generators and a random voltage source.
